# Hooked on Tails Bowfishing & Fishing Charters

Hooked on Tails offers New Orleans-area bowfishing and rod & reel fishing charters with Captain John Styron.

## Primary services

- New Orleans Bowfishing Charters: nighttime bowfishing trips in Louisiana marsh waters near New Orleans, Hopedale, Delacroix, and Shell Beach.
- Rod & Reel Fishing Charters: daytime Louisiana fishing trips targeting redfish, speckled trout, sheepshead, and other inshore species.

## Service areas

Hooked on Tails serves the New Orleans area and nearby Louisiana marsh areas including Hopedale, Delacroix, and Shell Beach. Exact meeting and launch details are provided after booking.
